newsitem.title: USA: Dole would pledge "No Macarena" - wife.
newsitem.headline: Dole would pledge "No Macarena" - wife.

text.p: Elizabeth Dole offered voters a fresh incentive on Friday to elect her husband president of the United States: no more Macarena.

The pledge to ban the popular dance craze from a future Republican White House led Elizabeth Dole's "Top Ten Reasons to Elect Bob Dole President" in a taped appearance on the "Late Show with David Letterman" on CBS.
1. Read my lips: no more Macarena.
2. President Dole will pardon all gap-toothed talk show hosts for speeding tickets in Connecticut.
3. The State of the Union message will be more exciting because you never know if Bob will stage dive and surf the crowd.
4. No more hog calling at the annual White House Easter egg roll.
5. White House chiefs of staff will be Sirajul and Mujibur (regular characters on the Letterman show).
6. There'll be no more Big Macs at White House state dinners.
7. President Dole would make Dave's Mom a White House correspondent
8. Dole and Kemp are two four-letter words you can teach your children.
9. Our dog, Leader, is much better at stupid pet tricks that Clintons' cat, Socks.
10. He'll cut your taxes 15 percent, and he'll cut your lawn too.
